cues.text: You and Akihiko stand together outside Iwatodai Station.
Akihiko remembers a moment in the dorm lounge: the others seated on the sofas while Yukari stands and speaks to him.
The men from the strip mall walk up with three more of their gang and spread out around you and Akihiko. Akihiko turns to face them, scowling.
Akihiko raises his fists, and you reach a hand out to him. Then the two of you turn and run, leaving the gang standing.
